headline: Adoption of a collective bargaining agreement with the Portland Administrators Association, plus a preview of the Fiscal 2028 Capital Improvement Plan.
summary: An executive session on negotiations with the Portland Administrators Association is also listed. Personnel changes, probationary teacher candidates, and two briefs on family engagement and enrollment trends are on the agenda too.
items: Public comment on items not on the agenda
Adoption of the collective bargaining agreement with the Portland Administrators Association (PAA)
Executive session on negotiations with PAA
Musical performance by the Casco Bay High School Chorus and proclamations for Abby Hutchins, Alison Perkins, and Joseph Russo
Board and community workshop on middle schools
Superintendent remarks and review of personnel changes, including separations and new hires
Brief on family and community engagement
Preview of the Fiscal 2028 Capital Improvement Plan and future Environmental Service Company (ESCO) work
location: Casco Bay High School (in person) and Zoom
